summary.en: The six panels gather into one card at main size; the title rises, language tabs and code enter, the highlight steps tab to tab leading edge first, and Run takes the accent.
summary.zh: 六块面板收成一张主尺寸的卡片；标题升起，语言标签和代码进场，高亮前沿先动、逐个切换标签，最后运行按钮接过强调色。

fits: The demo beat of a developer product: one call shown in several languages.
notFor: More than four tabs; code lines over 44 characters.

intent.en: A whole interface narrows to one call shown in the viewer's language of choice, so 'it works in yours' is seen.
intent.zh: 整个界面收成一个调用，用观众自己的语言展示，“你的语言也能用”是看见的。

content.en: A title (≤ 28 / 12 字), 1–4 tabs (language, 1–3 code lines ≤ 44 chars), the Run label (≤ 6 chars / 3 字).
content.zh: 标题（≤ 28 字符 / 12 字），1–4 个标签页（语言名，1–3 行代码，每行 ≤ 44 字符），运行按钮文字（≤ 6 字符 / 3 字）。

fits.zh: 开发者产品的演示拍：一个调用用几种语言展示。

notFor.zh: 超过四个标签页；超过 44 字符的代码行。

en: The highlight moves leading edge first; jumping both edges at once reads as a cut.
zh: 高亮要前沿先动；两边同时跳读起来像剪切。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
